line_items.work_text: Seismic Requalification of Existing Bridges in Assam under State Disaster Mitigation Fund for the year 2023-24
Protection and prevention of NH 15 to Alagachar connecting road from flood damages under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Darrang District, Mangaldoi LAC
Protection and prevention of MPK Road by providing Disaster Mitigation Measures under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Darrang District, Sipajhar LAC
Protection and prevention of Padmajhar to Andherighat Jayantipur providing Disaster Mitigation Measures under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Darrang District, Sipajhar LAC
Protection and prevention of Krishna Nagar area under North Guwahati revenue circle from landslide hazard near Aswaklanta Devalaya under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Kamrup District, Jalukbari LAC

narrative: The 16th Appraisal committee held on 23rd December, 2025 recommended the proposals and directed to place it before the SEC.
